2,930 likes, 7 comments - 47prodoffl on October 18, 2026: "Seven CPL teams—but is the Caribbean producing enough players to sustain them?

Otis Gibson says West Indies cricket must broaden its search and invest more seriously in unearthing new talent. Expansion creates opportunity, but the quality of the competition depends on building a player pool deep enough to support it.

Where should the Caribbean be looking for its next generation of cricketers?

🎙️ The Champions Corner with Otis Gibson | Episode 1

#TheChampionsCorner #OtisGibson #CPL #CaribbeanCricket #CricketDevelopment #CricketTalent #FutureOfCricket".
